jobs.description:
Assistant Chef de Bar (m/w/d) — Grand Hotel Kronenhof, Pontresina (Engadin, Graubünden). Pensum: 100%. Vertrag: Saisonstelle / Seasonal. Stellenantritt: 2026-09-01.

## This is what you move with us
• Supporting the Bar Manager in managing the team and organising the bar area (complaints management, staff management, staff training, shift planning)

• Ensuring exemplary guest service and smooth operations during shifts

• Preparation and presentation of drinks in compliance with high quality standards

• Ensuring cleanliness and tidiness in the bar area

• Carrying out orders and stock management for the bar

• Cashing up on the TCPOS cash register system & preparing the daily accounts

• Working closely with the Bar Manager and other departments to ensure seamless service

• Training and mentoring of bar staff to ensure excellent customer service

• Adhering to hotel policies and procedures in bar operations

## This is you
• Completed professional training

• At least 2 years of professional experience in the luxury hotel industry in the bar area

• Excellent knowledge of German and English, knowledge of other languages an advantage

• Extensive knowledge in the preparation of classic and modern cocktails and other drinks

• Knowledge of cigars and advising guests

• Organisational talent

• Stylish appearance, friendliness and charisma

• Ability to work in a team, flexibility and a pronounced guest service orientation

• We are looking for a long-term cooperation in this position.

## Benefits
At the Kulm Group, our people are the key to our success. That’s why we have a reputation for impeccable service. Our shared passion for high-end luxury, winter sports, haute cuisine and uncompromising service makes every stay unforgettable. When you work with us, we invest in you and provide you with the perfect platform to launch your career. All our team enjoy a wealth of amenities and perks, from comfortable accommodation and culinary delicacies, to our newly renovated staff lounge and free access to on-site fitness rooms. For us, providing the best employee experience is what sets our hospitality apart.
• Competitive      salary

• We continually strive to find new ways to reward our teams,      providing development opportunities, access to facilities and generous      discounts throughout the year.

• We offer discounted stays to family and friends at the Grand Hotel      Kronenhof or Kulm Hotel for the special rate of CHF 150 or CHF 200 a night      including breakfast in a single or a double room.

• Parents and partners receive 20% off on meals and drinks at Chesa      al Parc, Kulm Country Club, The Pizzeria in St. Moritz or Le Pavillion in      Pontresina.

• 40% off on spa treatments, coiffeur and private purchase of goods      and services.

• Free use of the tennis courts at Kulm Hotel St Moritz.

• Discounts on tennis and golf lessons.

• Free use of the golf course with a licence or driving range.

• Day ski pass for CHF 45 per person for Corvatsch.

• Diavolezza/Lagalb and 1 Corvatsch Ski Night for free.

Apply now

Sostenere il Bar Manager nella gestione del team e nell'organizzazione dell'area bar (gestione reclami, gestione del personale, formazione del personale, pianificazione dei turni) Garantire un servizio clienti esemplare e operazioni fluide durante i turni Preparazione e presentazione di bevande in conformità con gli standard di alta qualità Garantire la pulizia e la tidiosità nell'area bar Eseguire ordini e la gestione delle scorte per la barra Contanti sul sistema di cassa TCPOS e preparare i conti giornalieri Lavorare a stretto contatto con il Bar Manager e altri dipartimenti per garantire un servizio senza soluzione di continuità Formazione e mento del personale a barre per garantire un eccellente servizio clienti Questa è la formazione professionale completa Almeno 2 anni di esperienza professionale nel settore alberghiero di lusso nell'area bar Ottima conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese, conoscenza di altre lingue un vantaggio Ampia conoscenza nella preparazione di cocktail classici e moderni e altre bevande La conoscenza dei sigari e consigliare gli ospiti Stiamo cercando una cooperazione a lungo termine in questa posizione. Vantaggi Al Kulm Group, la nostra gente è la chiave del nostro successo. Ecco perché abbiamo una reputazione per un servizio impeccabile. La nostra passione condivisa per il lusso di fascia alta, gli sport invernali, l'alta cucina e il servizio senza compromessi rende ogni soggiorno indimenticabile. Quando lavori con noi, investiamo in te e ti forniamo la piattaforma perfetta per lanciare la tua carriera. Tutti i nostri team godono di una ricchezza di servizi e vantaggi, da sistemazioni confortevoli e prelibatezze culinarie, alla nostra nuova sala personale rinnovata e l'accesso gratuito alle sale fitness in loco. Per noi, fornire la migliore esperienza dei dipendenti è ciò che distingue la nostra ospitalità. stipendio competitivo Ci sforziamo continuamente di trovare nuovi modi per premiare i nostri team, fornendo opportunità di sviluppo, accesso alle strutture e sconti generosi durante tutto l'anno. Offriamo soggiorni scontati a famiglia e amici al Grand Hotel Kronenhof o Kulm Hotel per la tariffa speciale di CHF 150 o CHF 200 a notte compresa la colazione in una camera singola o doppia. Genitori e partner ricevono il 20% di sconto sui pasti e bevande presso Chesa al Parc, Kulm Country Club, The Pizzeria in St. Moritz o Le Pavillion a Pontresina. 40% di sconto sui trattamenti spa, coiffeur e acquisto privato di beni e servizi. Uso gratuito dei campi da tennis al Kulm Hotel St Moritz. Sconti sulle lezioni di tennis e golf. Uso gratuito del campo da golf con una licenza o un campo di guida. skipass giornaliero per CHF 45 a persona per Corvatsch. Diavolezza/Lagalb e 1 Corvatsch Ski Night gratis. Richiedi ora Assistant Restaurant Manager – Chesa al Parc (m/w/d) Kulm Hotel Persone a 1800m sul livello del mare stanno modellando il Luxury Mountain Travel. La nostra comunità dinamica e internazionale offre ai nostri ospiti smart Luxury per un'esperienza di vacanza inimitabile. Come membro del gruppo Luxury Kulm fai parte della chiave del nostro successo. Insieme, rendiamo ogni soggiorno profondamente ispiratore, unico e distintivo. E come tale, abbracciamo la nostra cultura: lusso sobrio, ispirazione e un'esperienza di vita. Insieme, facciamo in modo che accada. Questa è la tua occasione per essere un membro della nostra cultura di modellazione: Questo è quello che ti muovi con noiChesa al Parc è l'oasi culinaria per gli ospiti dell'hotel, la gente del posto e gli appassionati di sport. Sia sulla nostra spaziosa terrazza solarium in estate, sulla pista di pattinaggio in inverno, o all'interno del nostro accogliente ristorante, serviamo specialità svizzere e classici internazionali al massimo livello. Come Assistant Restaurant Manager, non siete solo la spina dorsale operativa del ristorante, ma soprattutto la faccia della sede. Vivi e respiri l'ospitalità e crei esperienze memorabili che i nostri ospiti apprezzeranno molto dopo la loro visita. Le tue Responsabilità:Passione per il Servizio: gestisci la tua stazione all'interno del nostro servizio à la carte e anticipa i desideri dei nostri ospiti esigenti prima che siano espressi. Leadership: In assenza del Restaurant Manager, si assume con fiducia le operazioni, coordina il flusso di servizio giornaliero e funge da punto di riferimento affidabile per il nostro team internazionale. Garanzia di qualità: Garantisci che i nostri elevati standard di servizio sono costantemente mantenuti e supportano la cooperazione liscia e armoniosa tra i team di cucina e di servizio, sia davanti che dietro casa. Training & Team Spirit: Si assiste a salire a bordo e formare nuovi membri del team, guidando per esempio con un atteggiamento positivo e pratico che motiva l'intero team. Questa è la vostra qualità: Formazione completa in ospitalità, servizio ristorante, o una qualifica paragonabile. Esperienza: Almeno 5 anni di solida esperienza nel servizio à la carte. L'esperienza iniziale di leadership (ad esempio, come Shift Leader o Chef de Rang con responsabilità) è considerata un forte vantaggio. Lingue: Tedesco fluido e buone competenze in inglese sono essenziali per l'interazione quotidiana degli ospiti. Qualsiasi lingua aggiuntiva, soprattutto italiana, è un bene prezioso. Personalità: Lei è altamente resiliente, rimanere calmo e organizzato anche durante i periodi di servizio impegnati, e mantenere una chiara panoramica in ogni momento. Mindset: Hai una presenza naturale, elegante e calda. Per te, l'ospitalità non è solo un lavoro, ma una vera passione. BenefitsAt Kulm Group, i nostri dipendenti sono il cuore del nostro successo. Offriamo interessanti opportunità di sviluppo, sistemazioni confortevoli, pasti convenienti nel ristorante del personale, e numerosi vantaggi. Tutte le lingue aggiuntive che parli sono un vantaggio, aiutandoti a servire meglio la nostra clientela internazionale. Eccellente Manners: Con il vostro aspetto ben curato e modi eccezionali, lasciate un'impressione duratura sui nostri ospiti. Passione per la perfezione: hai un occhio per i dettagli e ti sforzi per la perfezione in tutto quello che fai. Il vostro entusiasmo per il lavoro si riflette nella qualità del vostro lavoro. ## This is what you move with us
• Leadership & Partnership: You confidently represent the Front Office Manager and work together to ensure seamless operations at the highest level.

• The Guest Journey: From a warm welcome to a smooth check-out, you ensure our guests' stay is truly unforgettable.

• Knowledge Sharing: You contribute your expertise through staff training and performance reviews, while maintaining clear and professional communication with all other departments.

• Point of Contact: You serve as the primary contact for our guests—competent, proactive, and solution-oriented at all times.

• Administrative Excellence: You are responsible for statistics and month-end closings, ensuring strict adherence to LHW, Forbes, and Kulm standards.

• Guest Experience: With your profound knowledge of the hotel and the local region, you inspire our guests and guarantee a unique, world-class experience.

## This is you
• Education & Experience: You hold a degree in hospitality or business, with at least 3 years of experience in the 5-star luxury hotel segment.

• Leadership Skills: You possess proven leadership experience and a genuine passion for delivering exceptional service.

• Personality: You have a sophisticated appearance, a true host’s heart, and find joy in personal guest interaction.

• Languages: Must-have: Native or bilingual fluency in German and excellent English. Additional languages are a distinct advantage.

• Start Date: Available from June; we offer both 10-month seasonal or permanent year-round positions.

At Kulm Group, our employees are the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodations, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks.

Apply now

Grand Hotel Kronenhof

100%

## This is what you move with us
• Station Ownership: You take full responsibility for your section, managing it with autonomy and ensuring every plate meets our 5-star standards.

• Agility: You are ready to step up whenever needed, demonstrating true ownership and reliability.

• Quality Guardian: You uphold the highest health and food safety regulations (HACCP) as a second nature, ensuring the well-being of our guests and colleagues.

• Operational Mastery: You organize your workspace with surgical precision and plan daily activities to ensure a flawless service, even during peak hours.

• Culinary Leadership: You act as a role model, embodying the Kulm principles and inspiring your team through continuous improvement and a "can-do" attitude.

## This is you
• Background: Completed professional culinary training and solid experience in a similar role—ideally within the luxury hospitality or high-end gastronomy sector.

• Language: You are fluent in at least one of the following languages: English, Italian or Spanish.

• Mindset: You possess excellent time-management skills and stay cool when the heat is on and feel drawn to an Argentinian brasserie concept.

• Spirit: You don't just work in a kitchen; you live for the "Understated Luxury" and the unique life experience that the Engadin offers.
Why Kulm Country Club? Here we deliver a bold approach with an exquisite Mountain Terroir menu, which emphasises nature, proximity and connection. Playful, cool and laid back.

At Kulm Group, our employees are the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodations, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks.

## This is what you move with us
• Welcome guests at the highest level and ensure the best guest experience

• Leading a team of Commis de Rang and service staff

• Ensuring a smooth service flow

• Advising guests on the selection of food and beverages according to their preferences and restrictions

• Ensuring compliance with service standards and guidelines of the hotel group

• Responsible for the proper setting and decoration of tables

• Active involvement in the development of new menus and food cards

## This is you
• Completed education in the gastronomy sector or equivalent professional experience

• Several years of experience in the service sector, preferably in upscale gastronomy

• Forte capacità organizzative, resilienza e uno stile di lavoro strutturato

A Kulm Group, i nostri dipendenti sono il cuore del nostro successo. Offriamo interessanti opportunità di sviluppo, sistemazioni confortevoli, pasti convenienti nel ristorante del personale, e numerosi vantaggi.

## This is what you move with us
Working in direct collaboration with the General Management, you bear overall responsibility for the Rooms Division and act as the driving force for quality and innovation:
• Strategic Leadership: You lead and inspire a team of approximately 80–120 employees through your direct reports (Front Office, Concierge, Reservations, Housekeeping, and Laundry).

• Guest Journey & Quality: You are responsible for the seamless implementation of Forbes and 5-star excellence standards. You don’t just analyze guest feedback; you transform it into tangible service innovations.

• Commercial Mindset: In close coordination with Revenue Management, Sales, and Marketing, you optimize occupancy and ADR. You are responsible for budget planning, forecasting, and cost control (labor and operating expenses) with a focus on maximum profitability.

• Process Pioneer: You drive digital transformation and optimize internal SOPs to minimize friction and maximize the time dedicated to the guest.

• Training: Constant training and continuous development of the teams.

• Host Mentality: You maintain a strong presence in the lobby, cultivate relationships with our discerning regular guests, and master complex complaint management with composure and charm.

## This is you
We are seeking an established leadership personality who thrives on complexity and views excellence as a way of life.
• Experience: You have completed a degree or vocational training in luxury hospitality and possess several years of leadership experience in a comparable position within the international 5-star hotel industry.

• Linguistic Proficiency: You are business fluent in both German and English. Due to our location and team structure, Italian is considered a very significant advantage.

jobs.description:
Housekeeping Director (m/w/d) — Kulm Hotel St. Moritz, St. Moritz (Engadin, Graubünden). Pensum: 100%. Vertrag: Unbefristet / Permanent. Stellenantritt: 2026-08-01.

## This is what you move with us
At Kulm Hotel St. Moritz, Housekeeping is the heart of our property. With 150 rooms and suites, 30 residences, staff accommodations, and magnificent public areas, we set benchmarks in alpine luxury hospitality. As Housekeeping Director, you are the strategic leader behind this demanding operation. You will lead the department with foresight, composure, and an uncompromising eye for aesthetics. In this key position, you will report directly to the EAM Rooms Division and be responsible for the Housekeeping department (approximately 50–80 employees):
•  Department Leadership & Vision: You oversee the overall aesthetics of the rooms division and ensure that Forbes, LQA, and our internal quality standards are not only achieved but consistently lived as benchmarks of excellence.

•  Management Leadership: You lead and coach the Housekeeping Manager and Laundry Manager, who oversee daily operations. Together, you continuously develop and enhance the departments.

•  Staff Accommodation & Residence Management: You hold overall responsibility for the administration and quality standards of staff housing and employee rooms. In addition, you serve as a professional and trusted point of contact for guests staying in our exclusive residences.

•  Financial Management: You are responsible for the department’s budget, monitor labor costs (P&L), coordinate purchasing activities, and plan investments for renovations and new acquisitions.

•  Cross-Department Collaboration: You work closely with Engineering, Laundry, and Front Office teams to ensure a seamless guest journey.

•  Sustainability & Innovation: You implement environmentally sustainable cleaning concepts and drive the digitalization of housekeeping processes.

•  Talent Development: You are responsible for long-term workforce planning, recruiting key positions, and developing talent within your large, international team.

## This is you
You are an accomplished professional who has already demonstrated the ability to successfully and efficiently lead large teams in the luxury hospitality industry.
•  Experience: You have a long-standing career in Housekeeping within five-star hotels and have successfully held a senior leadership position (e.g., Executive Housekeeper or Director) in properties of comparable size.

•  Leadership Skills: You are a leader who inspires through expertise and personal integrity. You know how to structure processes without compromising the flexibility required in a luxury hospitality environment.

•  Training & Development: You are passionate about continuously developing and empowering your team.

•  Digital Affinity: Confident user of computers and standard business software.

•  Language Skills: You are fluent in German and English. As a large portion of our team speaks Italian or Portuguese, Italian language skills are a significant advantage in your daily work.

•  Analytical Thinking: You enjoy working with figures, budgeting, forecasting, and modern hotel management systems.

•  Personality: You are characterized by professionalism, discretion, and exceptionally high aesthetic standards. Even during peak season, you maintain calmness, focus, and a clear overview.
  Why Kulm Hotel?
•  Opportunity to Shape the Future: A position of great trust with direct reporting to the General Manager and the opportunity to make a lasting impact on the future of our properties, both operationally and culturally.

•  Recognition & Appreciation: An environment that values your expertise in people management and provides the freedom to establish modern leadership practices at a world-class level.

•  Exclusivity: Work at one of the world’s most prestigious hospitality destinations, alongside a team that places great importance on collaboration and mutual support.

## Benefits
At Kulm Group, our employees are the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodations, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks.
